test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be different from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some oranges are yellows.

2. Some yellows are grapes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some oranges are grapes.

II. All grapes are yellows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Least possible venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15307a654e34fdefb1dc57cb894d970606f52161faad28a2f3cd7619f6741b3e.png] 

Conclusions:

**I. **Some oranges are grapes → Doesn't F**ollows** (It is possible but not definite,because there is no direct relation between 'orange' and 'grapes'.)

**II.** All grapes are yellows → Doesn't** Follows** (Because there is only some grapes which are yellow but not all,as shown in the venn diagram)

Hence,"**neither conclusion (I) nor (II)" **follows.
